thread:
hannah-cs: heads-up: AtlasMed flagged a week-of onboarding regression and asked for SLO reconciliation + provisional credit before the renewal meeting next Fri. they want a 1-page bundle and a short comms blurb. can ops/eng help? :eyes:
owen-ops: on it. quick summary: org uptime 99.52 over the 7d window; two brief latency windows on 2026-03-02 11:07-11:20 UTC and 2026-03-04 03:45-03:50 UTC. p95 peaked ~980ms during the first window. linking dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/metrics/atlasmed/slo
mike-sre: looked at traces for 03-02 window. root cause looks like a model swap + aggressive cache eviction during a burst of long-context requests. fallback routing increased fanout to smaller workers causing higher queueing and retries. mitigation: revert model swap for onboarding route, bump kv-cache, add transient autoscale headroom.
liz-sales: for the customer note, CS will propose a provisional credit. can finance/ops give a ballpark so I can prep the renewal talking points? also flagging AE to prep negotiation fallback.
owen-ops: provisional credit calc (pre-approval): uptime shortfall 0.48%, affected request volume ~15k, applied ratecard => provisional credit = "$2,050". command used: ```./slo-tools/credit --org atlasmed --from 2026-02-27 --to 2026-03-05 --format md```
legal-bot: reminder: for credits > $2k we need legal review before sending. cc @legal.
hannah-cs: ok i'll draft the note with the suggested phrasing: "We observed two short service degradations during your onboarding window. Our team has implemented mitigations and prepared an evidence bundle. Based on our SLOs, you are eligible for a provisional credit of $2,050. Full evidence attached; happy to walk through on a 15-min call."
owen-ops: evidence bundle uploaded: https://s3.redwood.ai/atlasmed/evidence/4987654321-atlasmed-bundle.zip (includes metrics.csv, traces.json, uptime.csv, credit_calc.md). Also added incident.md with top 3 root causes and mitigations.
mike-sre: one follow-up for the postmortem: capture kernel selection logs and cache miss curves so Product can advise on quantization/weights for next model swap.
hannah-cs: thanks team. i'll run the draft by @liz-sales and wait for legal signoff before we send. flagging renewal risk moderate until call complete. :calendar:
